title: Spell Recipe Database
description: Each spell is a 'recipe': core (sigil or central sign) + a set of signs with count/placement/orientation + symmetry. The matcher compares the user's composition against these recipes. 'composition' uses: { core, signs:[{id,count,placement,orientation,inverted}], symmetry }. placement ∈ {around, top, bottom, sides, front, back, ring, alternating, surrounds, satellite}. confidence indicates how well the glyph is known in the source material.
